spec:
Let next/execute defer new agent starts when observed account usage is ahead of a sustainable pace for the current reset window, and admit more when behind, within max_workers. Read allowance snapshots (used percent, window duration, resets_at) through a bounded provider adapter (Codex app-server rateLimits; Claude Code equivalent if available) and expose used vs target fraction in next output, with a wake_at for the recheck instead of polling. Pacing applies only at start boundaries; running leases are never interrupted, and human items/discovery interviews are not throttled. Calendar/reserve/tolerance live in POLICY.json settings. Changed vs old wording: no capacity ledger or reservation leases; it is a frontier/scheduling input alongside max_workers.

Migrated from GitHub issue #549 after the engine reset (#740).
title: Pace autonomous dispatch against subscription allowance windows
